# proxmox_node_startall (Resource)

Starts all guests of a node through `POST /nodes/{node}/startall` and waits for the worker.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_startall" "s" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  force    = true
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean)
- `max_workers` (Number)
- `vms` (Set of Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
